```cpp
    bool    bExtinguished{false};       // Quenched by volumetric smoke flag

    /**
     * @brief Evaluates normalized thermal intensity in range [0.0, 1.0].
     * Models combustion phase:
     * - [0, t_warmup): Linear ramp from 0.0 to 1.0.
     * - [t_warmup, t_lifetime - t_fade): Peak burn plateau at 1.0.
     * - [t_lifetime - t_fade, t_lifetime): Linear decay from 1.0 to 0.0.
     */
    [[nodiscard]] float GetThermalIntensity(float flCurrentTime) const noexcept {
        if (!bIsBurning || bExtinguished) {
            return 0.0f;
        }
        const float flElapsed = flCurrentTime - flIgnitionTime;
        if (flElapsed < 0.0f || flElapsed >= flLifetime) {
            return 0.0f;
        }
        if (flElapsed < flWarmupTime) {
            return (flWarmupTime > 1e-4f) ? (flElapsed / flWarmupTime) : 1.0f;
        }
        const float flDecayStart = flLifetime - flFadeTime;
        if (flElapsed >= flDecayStart) {
            const float flFadeElapsed = flElapsed - flDecayStart;
            return (flFadeTime > 1e-4f) ? std::max(0.0f, 1.0f - (flFadeElapsed / flFadeTime)) : 0.0f;
        }
        return 1.0f;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] bool IsActiveAtTime(float flCurrentTime) const noexcept {
        if (!bIsBurning || bExtinguished) {
            return false;
        }
        const float flElapsed = flCurrentTime - flIgnitionTime;
        return (flElapsed >= 0.0f && flElapsed < flLifetime);
    }
};

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Damage Evaluation Output Record
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct InfernoDamageRecord_t {
    bool    bInFire{false};
    float   flHealthDamage{0.0f};
    float   flArmorDamage{0.0f};
    float   flThermalIntensity{0.0f};
    float   flDistanceToClosestNode{9999.0f};
    int32_t nClosestNodeIndex{-1};
};

/**
 * @brief Authoritative Surface Combustion & Thermal Energy Grid (CInferno)
 * Reconstructed from server.dll Build 26598758:
 * - 64-node flame cluster storage (m_firePositions, m_BurnNormal, m_bFireIsBurning).
 * - Downward ground-snapping raycasting with displacement brush alignment.
 * - Dynamic 2D/3D surface propagation with slope climbing and obstacle clearance gates.
 * - Mutual interaction & immediate quench against CSmokeVoxelGrid (Morton 32^3 & 144u sphere).
 * - 1/3rd threshold full-quench rule ("Molotov extinguished: when %d/%d fire areas were covered").
 * - Area damage evaluation with tick-rate intervals, radial falloff, and exposure ramp timers.
 */
class CInfernoFireGrid {
public:
    CInfernoFireGrid();

    /**
     * @brief Spawns the combustion cluster at detonation origin.
     * Evaluates immediate smoke quench if detonated inside an active smoke cloud.
     */
    void Spawn(const Vector3& vecOrigin,
               int32_t nStartTick = 0,
               float flCurrentTime = 0.0f,
               const CSmokeVoxelGrid* pSmoke = nullptr,
               const TerrainRaycastFn& terrainQuery = nullptr);

    /**
     * @brief Per-tick simulation loop (VA 0x180346090 / RVA 0x00346090).
     * Executes check expired, mutual smoke extinguishment, surface spread, and timer decay.
     */
    void OnTick(float flCurrentTime,
                int32_t nCurrentTick,
                const CSmokeVoxelGrid* pActiveSmoke = nullptr,
                const TerrainRaycastFn& terrainQuery = nullptr);

    /**
     * @brief Flame node lifecycle & burnout evaluation (VA 0x180340bc0 / RVA 0x00340bc0).
     * Updates burning state; transitions to post-effect if all nodes burn out.
     */
    void CheckExpired(float flCurrentTime);

    /**
     * @brief Dynamic 2D/3D surface propagation algorithm (VA 0x18034ef00 / RVA 0x0034ef00).
     * Expands cluster nodes radially along terrain tangent planes up to 64 nodes.
     */
    int32_t SpreadStep(float flCurrentTime, const TerrainRaycastFn& terrainQuery = nullptr);

    /**
     * @brief Mutual Smoke Voxel Interaction & Extinguishment (server.dll RVA 0x00346330-0x0034645f).
     * Quenches nodes overlapping active smoke voxels or 144-unit core detonation sphere.
     * Quenches entire inferno if >= 1/3rd of active nodes are extinguished.
     */
    int32_t ExtinguishOverlappingSmoke(const CSmokeVoxelGrid& smokeGrid, float flCurrentTime = 0.0f);

     * @brief Extinguishes an individual flame node (VA 0x180344790 / RVA 0x00344790).
     */

    /**
     * @brief Extinguishes the entire inferno immediately.
     */
    void ExtinguishAll();

    /**
     * @brief Evaluates area damage and exposure ramp at target world position.
     * Reconstructed from CInferno::InfernoThink damage phase (VA 0x1803468c4).
     */
    [[nodiscard]] InfernoDamageRecord_t EvaluateDamageAtPosition(
        const Vector3& vecTargetPos,
        float flTargetExposureTime,
        float flCurrentTime) const;

    // State Inspection & Accessors
    [[nodiscard]] int32_t GetFireCount() const noexcept { return m_fireCount; }
    [[nodiscard]] int32_t GetActiveBurningCount() const noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] int32_t GetExtinguishedCount() const noexcept { return m_nExtinguishedFlames; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool    IsActive() const noexcept { return m_bActive && !m_bInPostEffectTime; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool    IsInPostEffect() const noexcept { return m_bInPostEffectTime; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool    WasCreatedInSmoke() const noexcept { return m_bWasCreatedInSmoke; }
    [[nodiscard]] const Vector3& GetSpawnLocation() const noexcept { return m_vecOriginalSpawnLocation; }
    [[nodiscard]] const InfernoFlameNode_t& GetNode(int32_t idx) const { return m_nodes[idx]; }
    [[nodiscard]] const Vector3& GetFirePosition(int32_t idx) const { return m_firePositions[idx]; }
    [[nodiscard]] const Vector3& GetBurnNormal(int32_t idx) const { return m_BurnNormal[idx]; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool    IsFireBurning(int32_t idx) const { return m_bFireIsBurning[idx]; }

    void GetBoundingBox(Vector3& outMin, Vector3& outMax) const noexcept;

    // Built-in Default Terrain Raycaster (Analytical Plane & Wave Displacement)
    static TerrainTraceHit_t DefaultTerrainRaycast(const Vector3& start, const Vector3& end) noexcept;

private:
    // Core Engine Schema Reconstructed Fields
    Vector3 m_firePositions[MAX_INFERNO_FIRES]{};       // +0x0850: Node world positions
    Vector3 m_fireParentPositions[MAX_INFERNO_FIRES]{}; // +0x0b50: Parent node positions

    Vector3 m_BurnNormal[MAX_INFERNO_FIRES]{};          // +0x0e90: Contact surface normals
    int32_t m_fireCount{0};                             // +0x1190: Allocated flame count (0..64)
    int32_t m_nInfernoType{0};                          // +0x1194: 0 = Molotov, 1 = Incendiary
    int32_t m_nFireEffectTickBegin{0};                  // +0x1198: Ignition start tick
    float   m_nFireLifetime{INFERNO_LIFETIME};          // +0x119c: Lifetime in seconds
    bool    m_bInPostEffectTime{false};                 // +0x11a0: Post-burn decay state
    bool    m_bWasCreatedInSmoke{false};                // +0x11a1: Quenched upon spawn inside smoke
    Vector3 m_extent{INFERNO_SPREAD_RADIUS, INFERNO_SPREAD_RADIUS, 64.0f}; // +0x13a8
    Vector3 m_vecOriginalSpawnLocation{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f}; // +0x1414
    int32_t m_nMaxFlames{MAX_INFERNO_FIRES};            // +0x1434: Max flame cap (64)

    // Simulation Internal State

    float   m_flSpawnTime{0.0f};
    float   m_flLastSpreadTime{0.0f};
    float   m_flLastDamageTime{0.0f};
```

```cpp
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

public:
    explicit CParticleSystemDefinition(std::string strName, uint32_t maxParticles = kDefaultMaxParticles)
        : m_strName(std::move(strName)), m_nMaxParticles(maxParticles) {}

    void AddEmitter(std::unique_ptr<IParticleEmitter> emitter) {
        m_Emitters.push_back(std::move(emitter));
    }
    void AddInitializer(std::unique_ptr<IParticleInitializer> initializer) {
        m_Initializers.push_back(std::move(initializer));
    }
    void AddOperator(std::unique_ptr<IParticleOperator> op) {
        m_Operators.push_back(std::move(op));
    }
    void SetRenderer(std::unique_ptr<IParticleRenderer> renderer) {
        m_pRenderer = std::move(renderer);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Executes a single simulation step: Emitters -> Initializers -> Operators.
     * @param pParticles Target particle collection.
     * @param flDeltaTime Step elapsed time in seconds.
     */
    void Step(CParticleCollection* pParticles, float flDeltaTime);

    /**
     * @brief Generates dynamic billboard geometry.
     */
    void Render(const CParticleCollection* pParticles,
                const Vector3D& vCamRight,
                const Vector3D& vCamUp,
                std::vector<ParticleQuadVertex>& outVertices,
                std::vector<uint32_t>& outIndices) const {
        if (m_pRenderer) {
            m_pRenderer->Render(pParticles, vCamRight, vCamUp, outVertices, outIndices);
        }
    }

    [[nodiscard]] const std::string& GetName() const noexcept { return m_strName; }
    [[nodiscard]] uint32_t GetMaxParticles() const noexcept { return m_nMaxParticles; }

private:
    std::string m_strName;
    uint32_t    m_nMaxParticles{kDefaultMaxParticles};

    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<IParticleEmitter>>     m_Emitters;
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<IParticleInitializer>> m_Initializers;
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<IParticleOperator>>    m_Operators;
    std::unique_ptr<IParticleRenderer>                 m_pRenderer;
};
```

```cpp
    constexpr Vector3(float _x, float _y, float _z) noexcept : x(_x), y(_y), z(_z) {}

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Vector3 operator+(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Vector3 operator-(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Vector3 operator*(float s) const noexcept { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Vector3 operator/(float s) const noexcept { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr float Dot(const Vector3& o) const noexcept { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }
    [[nodiscard]] float LengthSqr() const noexcept { return Dot(*this); }
    [[nodiscard]] float Length() const noexcept { return std::sqrt(LengthSqr()); }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3 Normalized() const noexcept {
        const float len = Length();
        return (len > 1e-6f) ? (*this / len) : Vector3{0, 0, 0};
```

```cpp
#ifndef CS2_PULSE_INTERPRETER_H
#define CS2_PULSE_INTERPRETER_H

#include <vector>

namespace cs2::pulse_system {

enum class PulseOpcode : uint16_t {
    NOP = 0,
    LOAD_INT = 1,
    LOAD_FLOAT = 2,
    MOVE = 3,
    ADD_INT = 4,
    SUB_INT = 5,
    MUL_FLOAT = 6,
    JUMP = 7,
    JUMP_IF_ZERO = 8,
    CALL_DOMAIN_METHOD = 9,
    YIELD = 10,
    RETURN = 11
};

/**
 * @brief 56-byte aligned instruction descriptor matching pulse_system.dll @ 0x18008f810.
 */
struct alignas(8) PGDInstruction_t {
    PulseOpcode opcode{PulseOpcode::NOP};
    uint16_t flags{0};
    uint16_t dstReg{0};
    uint16_t srcRegA{0};
    uint16_t srcRegB{0};
    uint16_t pad{0};
    int64_t immInt{0};
    double immDouble{0.0};
    uint64_t domainMethodId{0};
    uint64_t extraData[2]{0, 0};
};
static_assert(sizeof(PGDInstruction_t) == 56, "PGDInstruction_t must match exactly 56 bytes");

enum class FiberState : uint8_t {
    Ready = 0,
    Running = 1,
    Yielded = 2,
    Terminated = 3
};

struct PulseFiber_t {
    uint32_t fiberId{0};
    FiberState state{FiberState::Ready};
    size_t programCounter{0};
    int64_t registers[16]{0};
};

/**
 * @brief Reconstructed Pulse Interpreter Engine from pulse_system.dll.
 */
class CPulseInterpreter {
public:
    CPulseInterpreter() = default;

    /**
     * @brief Loads program instructions into bytecode cache.
     */
    void LoadProgram(std::vector<PGDInstruction_t> instructions);

    /**
     * @brief Spawns a new execution fiber coroutine.
     */
    uint32_t SpawnFiber();

    /**
     * @brief Executes instructions for a fiber until yield or return.
     * Matches PulseInstructionDispatchLoop @ 0x18008f810.
     */
    FiberState StepFiber(uint32_t fiberId, size_t maxSteps = 1000);

    [[nodiscard]] const PulseFiber_t* GetFiber(uint32_t fiberId) const;

private:
    std::vector<PGDInstruction_t> m_Code;
    std::vector<PulseFiber_t> m_Fibers;
    uint32_t m_NextFiberId{1};
```

### File: `game/resourcesystem/kv3_parser.h` (resourcesystem.dll)
```cpp
#ifndef CS2_RESOURCESYSTEM_KV3_PARSER_H
#define CS2_RESOURCESYSTEM_KV3_PARSER_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>
#include <variant>
#include <span>
#include <optional>
#include <memory>
#include <array>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <sstream>
#include <iomanip>

namespace cs2::resourcesystem {

// Forward declarations
class KV3Value;
using KV3Array = std::vector<KV3Value>;
using KV3Table = std::vector<std::pair<std::string, KV3Value>>;
using KV3Blob  = std::vector<std::uint8_t>;

/**
 * @brief 128-bit Universally Unique Identifier for KV3 format and encoding specifications.
 */
struct KV3Guid_t {
    std::array<std::uint8_t, 16> m_bytes{};

    constexpr KV3Guid_t() noexcept = default;
    constexpr explicit KV3Guid_t(const std::array<std::uint8_t, 16>& bytes) noexcept : m_bytes(bytes) {}

    static KV3Guid_t Parse(std::string_view str);
    [[nodiscard]] std::string ToString() const;

    constexpr bool operator==(const KV3Guid_t& other) const noexcept {
        return m_bytes == other.m_bytes;
    }
    constexpr bool operator!=(const KV3Guid_t& other) const noexcept {
        return m_bytes != other.m_bytes;
    }
};

// Canonical Valve KV3 GUID definitions
inline constexpr std::array<std::uint8_t, 16> g_GuidTextEncoding = {
    0xe2, 0x1c, 0x7f, 0x3c, 0x8a, 0x33, 0x41, 0xc5, 0x99, 0x77, 0xa7, 0x6d, 0x3a, 0x32, 0xaa, 0x0d
};
inline constexpr std::array<std::uint8_t, 16> g_GuidGenericFormat = {
    0x74, 0x47, 0x72, 0x21, 0x4c, 0x60, 0x44, 0xd8, 0xa1, 0x4a, 0x03, 0x83, 0x8b, 0x55, 0x8f, 0x68
};
inline constexpr std::array<std::uint8_t, 16> g_GuidBinaryKV3BlockLZ4 = {
    0x46, 0x01, 0x27, 0xb0, 0x8c, 0x20, 0x48, 0x23, 0x91, 0x56, 0x9e, 0x16, 0x6f, 0x9e, 0x66, 0xcb
};

/**
 * @brief Compression schemes applied to binary KeyValues3 streams.
 */
enum class KV3CompressionType : std::uint32_t {
    None = 0,
    LZ4  = 1,
    ZSTD = 2,
    Unknown = 0xFFFFFFFF
};

/**
 * @brief Runtime type identifier for dynamic KV3 values.
 */
enum class KV3Type : std::uint8_t {
    Null = 0,
    Boolean = 1,
    Integer = 2,
    Double = 3,
    String = 4,
    BinaryBlob = 5,
    Array = 6,
    Table = 7
};

/**
 * @brief Dynamic recursive value tree container representing an arbitrary KeyValues3 node.
 */
class KV3Value {
public:
    using Storage = std::variant<
        std::monostate, // Null
        bool,           // Boolean
        std::int64_t,   // Integer
        double,         // Double
        std::string,    // String
        KV3Blob,        // Binary Blob
        KV3Array,       // Array
        KV3Table        // Table / Object
    >;

private:
    Storage m_storage{std::monostate{}};

public:
    KV3Value() noexcept = default;
    KV3Value(std::nullptr_t) noexcept : m_storage(std::monostate{}) {}
    KV3Value(bool val) noexcept : m_storage(val) {}
    KV3Value(std::int64_t val) noexcept : m_storage(val) {}
    KV3Value(std::int32_t val) noexcept : m_storage(static_cast<std::int64_t>(val)) {}
    KV3Value(std::uint32_t val) noexcept : m_storage(static_cast<std::int64_t>(val)) {}
    KV3Value(std::uint64_t val) noexcept : m_storage(static_cast<std::int64_t>(val)) {}
    KV3Value(double val) noexcept : m_storage(val) {}
    KV3Value(float val) noexcept : m_storage(static_cast<double>(val)) {}
    KV3Value(std::string str) : m_storage(std::move(str)) {}
    KV3Value(std::string_view sv) : m_storage(std::string(sv)) {}
    KV3Value(const char* sz) : m_storage(sz ? std::string(sz) : std::string{}) {}
    KV3Value(KV3Blob blob) : m_storage(std::move(blob)) {}
    KV3Value(KV3Array arr) : m_storage(std::move(arr)) {}
    KV3Value(KV3Table tbl) : m_storage(std::move(tbl)) {}

    [[nodiscard]] KV3Type GetType() const noexcept {
        return static_cast<KV3Type>(m_storage.index());
    }

    [[nodiscard]] bool IsNull() const noexcept { return std::holds_alternative<std::monostate>(m_storage); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsBool() const noexcept { return std::holds_alternative<bool>(m_storage); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsInt() const noexcept { return std::holds_alternative<std::int64_t>(m_storage); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsDouble() const noexcept { return std::holds_alternative<double>(m_storage); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsString() const noexcept { return std::holds_alternative<std::string>(m_storage); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsBlob() const noexcept { return std::holds_alternative<KV3Blob>(m_storage); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsArray() const noexcept { return std::holds_alternative<KV3Array>(m_storage); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool IsTable() const noexcept { return std::holds_alternative<KV3Table>(m_storage); }

    [[nodiscard]] bool AsBool(bool defaultVal = false) const noexcept {
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<bool>(&m_storage)) return *p;
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<std::int64_t>(&m_storage)) return *p != 0;
        return defaultVal;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] std::int64_t AsInt(std::int64_t defaultVal = 0) const noexcept {
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<std::int64_t>(&m_storage)) return *p;
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<double>(&m_storage)) return static_cast<std::int64_t>(*p);
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<bool>(&m_storage)) return *p ? 1 : 0;
        return defaultVal;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] double AsDouble(double defaultVal = 0.0) const noexcept {
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<double>(&m_storage)) return *p;
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<std::int64_t>(&m_storage)) return static_cast<double>(*p);
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<bool>(&m_storage)) return *p ? 1.0 : 0.0;
        return defaultVal;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] const std::string& AsString(const std::string& defaultVal = "") const noexcept {
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<std::string>(&m_storage)) return *p;
        return defaultVal;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] const KV3Blob& AsBlob() const {
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<KV3Blob>(&m_storage)) return *p;
        static const KV3Blob s_emptyBlob;
        return s_emptyBlob;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] KV3Blob& AsBlob() {
        if (!IsBlob()) m_storage = KV3Blob{};
        return std::get<KV3Blob>(m_storage);
    }

    [[nodiscard]] const KV3Array& AsArray() const {
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<KV3Array>(&m_storage)) return *p;
        static const KV3Array s_emptyArr;
        return s_emptyArr;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] KV3Array& AsArray() {
        if (!IsArray()) m_storage = KV3Array{};
        return std::get<KV3Array>(m_storage);
    }

    [[nodiscard]] const KV3Table& AsTable() const {
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<KV3Table>(&m_storage)) return *p;
        static const KV3Table s_emptyTbl;
        return s_emptyTbl;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] KV3Table& AsTable() {
        if (!IsTable()) m_storage = KV3Table{};
        return std::get<KV3Table>(m_storage);
    }

    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t Size() const noexcept {
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<KV3Array>(&m_storage)) return p->size();
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<KV3Table>(&m_storage)) return p->size();
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<KV3Blob>(&m_storage)) return p->size();
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<std::string>(&m_storage)) return p->size();
        return 0;
    }

    // Table operations
    [[nodiscard]] bool HasKey(std::string_view key) const noexcept {
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<KV3Table>(&m_storage)) {
            return std::any_of(p->begin(), p->end(), [key](const auto& pair) {
                return pair.first == key;
            });
        }
        return false;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] const KV3Value* Find(std::string_view key) const noexcept {
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<KV3Table>(&m_storage)) {
            for (const auto& pair : *p) {
                if (pair.first == key) return &pair.second;
            }
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] KV3Value* Find(std::string_view key) noexcept {
        if (auto* p = std::get_if<KV3Table>(&m_storage)) {
            for (auto& pair : *p) {
                if (pair.first == key) return &pair.second;
            }
        }
        return nullptr;
    }

    KV3Value& operator[](std::string_view key) {
        if (!IsTable()) m_storage = KV3Table{};
        auto& tbl = std::get<KV3Table>(m_storage);
        for (auto& pair : tbl) {
            if (pair.first == key) return pair.second;
        }
        tbl.emplace_back(std::string(key), KV3Value{});
        return tbl.back().second;
    }

    const KV3Value& operator[](std::string_view key) const {
        const auto* ptr = Find(key);
        if (ptr) return *ptr;
        static const KV3Value s_nullValue;
        return s_nullValue;
    }

    // Array operations
    void PushBack(KV3Value value) {
        if (!IsArray()) m_storage = KV3Array{};
        std::get<KV3Array>(m_storage).push_back(std::move(value));
    }

    KV3Value& operator[](std::size_t index) {
        if (!IsArray()) m_storage = KV3Array{};
        auto& arr = std::get<KV3Array>(m_storage);
        if (index >= arr.size()) arr.resize(index + 1);
        return arr[index];
    }

    const KV3Value& operator[](std::size_t index) const {
        if (const auto* p = std::get_if<KV3Array>(&m_storage)) {
            if (index < p->size()) return (*p)[index];
        }
        static const KV3Value s_nullValue;
        return s_nullValue;
    }

    bool operator==(const KV3Value& other) const;
    bool operator!=(const KV3Value& other) const { return !(*this == other); }
};

// ============================================================================
// Source 2 Compiled Resource Containers (resourcesystem.dll)

#pragma pack(push, 1)

/**
 * @brief Canonical Source 2 Compiled Resource Header ("VASU").
 * Binary signature: 0x55534156 ("VASU" in little-endian representation).
 */
struct ResourceHeader_t {
    std::uint32_t m_nMagic;         // 0x00: 0x55534156 ("VASU")
    std::uint16_t m_nHeaderVersion; // 0x04: 12 (0x000C)
    std::uint16_t m_nVersion;       // 0x06: Resource compilation version
    std::uint32_t m_nFlags;         // 0x08: Resource compiler flags
    std::uint32_t m_nBlockOffset;   // 0x0C: Offset to block descriptor table
    std::uint32_t m_nBlockCount;    // 0x10: Number of embedded resource blocks
};

/**
 * @brief Descriptor entry for individual resource data blocks.
 */
struct ResourceBlockEntry_t {
    std::uint32_t m_nBlockId;       // 0x00: FourCC ('DATA', 'RED2', 'RERL', etc.)
    std::uint32_t m_nOffset;        // 0x04: Absolute offset from start of file
    std::uint32_t m_nSize;          // 0x08: Uncompressed byte length
};

#pragma pack(pop)

/**
 * @brief FourCC identifier helper.
 */
constexpr std::uint32_t MakeFourCC(char a, char b, char c, char d) noexcept {
    return static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(a)) |
          (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(b)) << 8) |
          (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(c)) << 16) |
          (static_cast<std::uint32_t>(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(d)) << 24);
}

// Well-known block identifiers
inline constexpr std::uint32_t RESOURCE_MAGIC_VASU = 0x55534156;
inline constexpr std::uint32_t BLOCK_FOURCC_DATA   = MakeFourCC('D', 'A', 'T', 'A');
inline constexpr std::uint32_t BLOCK_FOURCC_RED2   = MakeFourCC('R', 'E', 'D', '2');
inline constexpr std::uint32_t BLOCK_FOURCC_RERL   = MakeFourCC('R', 'E', 'R', 'L');
inline constexpr std::uint32_t BLOCK_FOURCC_REDI   = MakeFourCC('R', 'E', 'D', 'I');
inline constexpr std::uint32_t BLOCK_FOURCC_VBIB   = MakeFourCC('V', 'B', 'I', 'B');

/**
 * @brief Compiled resource external reference entry.
 */
struct ResourceExternalRef_t {
    std::uint64_t m_nHash{0};
    std::string m_szAssetPath;
};

/**
 * @brief In-memory representation of a Source 2 compiled resource container.
 */
class CResourceFile {
public:
    ResourceHeader_t m_header{};
    std::vector<ResourceBlockEntry_t> m_blockEntries;
    std::vector<ResourceExternalRef_t> m_externalReferences;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> m_rawBuffer;

    CResourceFile() = default;

    bool LoadFromMemory(std::span<const std::uint8_t> buffer);
    [[nodiscard]] std::span<const std::uint8_t> GetBlockData(std::uint32_t blockFourCC) const;
    [[nodiscard]] bool HasBlock(std::uint32_t blockFourCC) const noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] bool UnpackDataBlockAsKV3(CKV3Document& outDoc) const;

    [[nodiscard]] static std::vector<std::uint8_t> BuildContainer(
        std::span<const std::uint8_t> dataBlockPayload,
        const std::vector<std::string>& externalRefs = {}
    );
};

#endif // CS2_RESOURCESYSTEM_KV3_PARSER_H
```

### File: `game/schemasystem/schemasystem.h` (schemasystem.dll)

```cpp
#ifndef CS2_SCHEMASYSTEM_H
#define CS2_SCHEMASYSTEM_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace cs2::schemasystem {

struct SchemaField {
    std::string name;
    std::string type;
    int32_t offset;
};

struct SchemaClass {
    std::string name;
    std::string moduleName;
    int32_t size;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, SchemaField> fields;
};

/**
 * @brief Reconstructed CSchemaSystem from schemasystem.dll
 * Verified MurmurHash2 implementation matching schemasystem.dll @ 0x180010380.
 */
class CSchemaSystem {
public:
    static CSchemaSystem& Get();

    static constexpr uint32_t MurmurHash2(std::string_view str) noexcept {
        const uint32_t len = static_cast<uint32_t>(str.length());
        if (len == 0) return 0;

        constexpr uint32_t m = 0x5bd1e995;
        constexpr int r = 24;

        uint32_t h = len ^ 0xbaadfeed;
        const char* data = str.data();
        uint32_t remaining = len;

        while (remaining >= 4) {
            uint32_t k = static_cast<uint8_t>(data[0]) |
                        (static_cast<uint8_t>(data[1]) << 8) |
                        (static_cast<uint8_t>(data[2]) << 16) |
                        (static_cast<uint8_t>(data[3]) << 24);

            k *= m;
            k ^= k >> r;
            k *= m;

            h *= m;
            h ^= k;

            data += 4;
            remaining -= 4;
        }

        if (remaining == 3) h ^= static_cast<uint8_t>(data[2]) << 16;
        if (remaining >= 2) h ^= static_cast<uint8_t>(data[1]) << 8;
        if (remaining >= 1) {
            h ^= static_cast<uint8_t>(data[0]);
            h *= m;
        }

        h ^= h >> 13;
        h *= m;
        h ^= h >> 15;

        return h;
    }

    void RegisterClass(const std::string& moduleName, const std::string& className, int32_t classSize);
    void RegisterField(const std::string& className, const std::string& fieldName, const std::string& type, int32_t offset);

    [[nodiscard]] const SchemaClass* FindDeclaredClass(const std::string& className) const;
    [[nodiscard]] int32_t GetFieldOffset(const std::string& className, const std::string& fieldName) const;

private:
    CSchemaSystem();
    std::unordered_map<std::string, SchemaClass> m_Classes;
};

} // namespace cs2::schemasystem

#endif // CS2_SCHEMASYSTEM_H
```

```cpp
    [[nodiscard]] inline const CTransform* GetTransform() const noexcept {
        CGameSceneNode* pNode = GetSceneNode();
        return pNode ? &pNode->m_nodeToWorld : nullptr;
    }
};

static_assert(sizeof(CBaseEntity) == 0x4A8, "CBaseEntity total footprint must be exactly 0x4a8 (1192 bytes)");
```

```cpp
namespace cs2::server {

constexpr uint32_t INVALID_EHANDLE = 0xFFFFFFFF;
constexpr uint32_t ENTRY_INDEX_MASK = 0x7FFF;
constexpr uint32_t SERIAL_NUMBER_SHIFT = 15;

/**
 * @brief 32-bit CEntityHandle packed bitfield
 * Bits 0..14: Entry Index (0..32,767)
 * Bits 15..31: Serial Number (ABA protection)
 */
struct EntityHandle {
    uint32_t raw = INVALID_EHANDLE;

    constexpr EntityHandle() noexcept = default;
    constexpr explicit EntityHandle(uint32_t val) noexcept : raw(val) {}
    constexpr EntityHandle(uint32_t entryIndex, uint32_t serialNum) noexcept
        : raw((entryIndex & ENTRY_INDEX_MASK) | (serialNum << SERIAL_NUMBER_SHIFT)) {}

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsValid() const noexcept { return raw != INVALID_EHANDLE; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr uint32_t GetEntryIndex() const noexcept { return raw & ENTRY_INDEX_MASK; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr uint32_t GetSerialNumber() const noexcept { return raw >> SERIAL_NUMBER_SHIFT; }
};

struct PlayerPawn {
    EntityHandle handle;
    EntityHandle controllerHandle;
    int health = 100;
    bool isAlive = true;
    bool isBot = false;
};

struct PlayerController {
    EntityHandle handle;
    EntityHandle pawnHandle;
    std::string playerName;
    int ping = 15;
    int score = 0;
};

 * @brief Reconstructed Controller vs Pawn Topology from server.dll

class CPlayerLifecycleManager {
public:
```

```cpp
#ifndef CS2_SERVER_LAGCOMPENSATION_H
#define CS2_SERVER_LAGCOMPENSATION_H

#include "../client/viewmatrix.h"
#include "controller_pawn.h"
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
#include <deque>
#include <array>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <numbers>

namespace cs2::server {

using client::Vector3;
using client::QAngle;

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Authoritative Engine Constants & Virtual Offsets (server.dll @ Build 26598758)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
constexpr uintptr_t VTABLE_LAGCOMPENSATION_MANAGER = 0x1819c7650;
constexpr uintptr_t VA_START_LAG_COMPENSATION      = 0x180ED27D0; // RVA: 0x00ED27D0
constexpr uintptr_t VA_FINISH_LAG_COMPENSATION     = 0x180EB8F40; // RVA: 0x00EB8F40
constexpr uintptr_t VA_RESTORE_ENTITY_TO           = 0x180ECDB00; // RVA: 0x00ECDB00
constexpr uintptr_t VA_BACKTRACK_PLAYER            = 0x180EC8950; // RVA: 0x00EC8950

constexpr int MAX_BONES = 128;
constexpr size_t RING_BUFFER_CAPACITY = 64;                  // 64-tick circular buffer (1.000s @ 64Hz)
constexpr float TICK_RATE = 64.0f;                           // Authoritative 64Hz simulation
constexpr float TICK_INTERVAL_64 = 1.0f / TICK_RATE;         // 0.015625s (1.0f / 64.0f)
constexpr float MAX_BACKTRACK_WINDOW = 0.200f;               // sv_maxunlag: 200ms (0.200s)
constexpr float TELEPORT_DISTANCE_SQR_THRESHOLD = 4096.0f;   // 64.0f^2 units: Discontinuity breaker
constexpr float SLERP_EPSILON = 0.9995f;                     // NLERP threshold for near-parallel quaternions

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Lag Record Bitflags (Reconstructed from FUN_180ecdb00 / RestoreEntityTo)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
constexpr uint8_t LAG_RECORD_RESTORED        = 0x01; // Bit 0: Record applied / active
constexpr uint8_t LAG_RECORD_ORIGIN_CHANGED  = 0x02; // Bit 1: World origin offset modified
constexpr uint8_t LAG_RECORD_ANGLES_CHANGED  = 0x04; // Bit 2: Eye angles / rotation modified
constexpr uint8_t LAG_RECORD_BOUNDS_CHANGED  = 0x08; // Bit 3: Collision mins/maxs modified
constexpr uint8_t LAG_RECORD_BONES_CHANGED   = 0x10; // Bit 4: Skeletal bone matrices cached

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Hypercomplex Unit Quaternion (Rotation Representation)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct Quaternion {
    float w = 1.0f;
    float x = 0.0f;
    float y = 0.0f;
    float z = 0.0f;

    constexpr Quaternion() noexcept = default;
    constexpr Quaternion(float inW, float inX, float inY, float inZ) noexcept
        : w(inW), x(inX), y(inY), z(inZ) {}

    static Quaternion FromAxisAngle(const Vector3& axis, float angleRadians) noexcept {
        const float half = angleRadians * 0.5f;
        const float s = std::sin(half);
        const float len = std::sqrt(axis.x * axis.x + axis.y * axis.y + axis.z * axis.z);
        if (len <= 1e-7f) return { 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };
        const float invLen = 1.0f / len;
        return { std::cos(half), axis.x * invLen * s, axis.y * invLen * s, axis.z * invLen * s };
    }

    static Quaternion FromEuler(float pitchDeg, float yawDeg, float rollDeg) noexcept {
        constexpr float degToRad = std::numbers::pi_v<float> / 180.0f;
        const float p = pitchDeg * degToRad * 0.5f;
        const float y = yawDeg * degToRad * 0.5f;
        const float r = rollDeg * degToRad * 0.5f;

        const float sp = std::sin(p), cp = std::cos(p);
        const float sy = std::sin(y), cy = std::cos(y);
        const float sr = std::sin(r), cr = std::cos(r);

        return {
            cr * cp * cy + sr * sp * sy,
            sr * cp * cy - cr * sp * sy,
            cr * sp * cy + sr * cp * sy,
            cr * cp * sy - sr * sp * cy
        };
    }

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr float Dot(const Quaternion& o) const noexcept {
        return w * o.w + x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] float Norm() const noexcept {
        return std::sqrt(w * w + x * x + y * y + z * z);
    }

    [[nodiscard]] Quaternion Normalized() const noexcept {
        const float n = Norm();
        if (n <= 1e-7f) return { 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f };
        const float inv = 1.0f / n;
        return { w * inv, x * inv, y * inv, z * inv };
    }

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Quaternion Conjugate() const noexcept {
        return { w, -x, -y, -z };
    }

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Quaternion operator*(const Quaternion& r) const noexcept {
        return {
            w * r.w - x * r.x - y * r.y - z * r.z,
            w * r.x + x * r.w + y * r.z - z * r.y,
            w * r.y - x * r.z + y * r.w + z * r.x,
            w * r.z + x * r.y - y * r.x + z * r.w
        };
    }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3 RotateVector(const Vector3& v) const noexcept {
        const Quaternion qv(0.0f, v.x, v.y, v.z);
        const Quaternion res = (*this) * qv * Conjugate();
        return { res.x, res.y, res.z };
    }

    /**
     * @brief Geodesic Shortest-Arc Spherical Linear Interpolation (SLERP) / NLERP
     * server.dll: shortest arc quaternion interpolation.
     */
    [[nodiscard]] static Quaternion Slerp(const Quaternion& q0, const Quaternion& q1, float t) noexcept {
        float cosTheta = q0.Dot(q1);
        Quaternion target = q1;

        // Take shortest geodesic arc path across 4D hypersphere
        if (cosTheta < 0.0f) {
            cosTheta = -cosTheta;
            target = { -q1.w, -q1.x, -q1.y, -q1.z };
        }

        // Small-angle threshold: use NLERP to prevent division by zero
        if (cosTheta > SLERP_EPSILON) {
            const float invT = 1.0f - t;
            Quaternion nlerp(
                invT * q0.w + t * target.w,
                invT * q0.x + t * target.x,
                invT * q0.y + t * target.y,
                invT * q0.z + t * target.z
            );
            return nlerp.Normalized();
        }

        const float theta = std::acos(std::clamp(cosTheta, -1.0f, 1.0f));
        const float sinTheta = std::sin(theta);
        const float w0 = std::sin((1.0f - t) * theta) / sinTheta;
        const float w1 = std::sin(t * theta) / sinTheta;

        return {
            w0 * q0.w + w1 * target.w,
            w0 * q0.x + w1 * target.x,
            w0 * q0.y + w1 * target.y,
            w0 * q0.z + w1 * target.z
        };
    }

    [[nodiscard]] bool BitwiseEqual(const Quaternion& o) const noexcept {
        return w == o.w && x == o.x && y == o.y && z == o.z;
    }
};

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Linear Algebra: 3x4 Affine Transformation Matrix (Row-Major)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct Matrix3x4 {
    float m[3][4]{};

    static constexpr Matrix3x4 Identity() noexcept {
        Matrix3x4 mat{};
        mat.m[0][0] = 1.0f;
        mat.m[1][1] = 1.0f;
        mat.m[2][2] = 1.0f;
        return mat;
    }

    static Matrix3x4 FromQuaternionTranslation(const Quaternion& q, const Vector3& pos) noexcept {
        Matrix3x4 mat{};
        const float xx = q.x * q.x;
        const float yy = q.y * q.y;
        const float zz = q.z * q.z;
        const float xy = q.x * q.y;
        const float xz = q.x * q.z;
        const float yz = q.y * q.z;
        const float wx = q.w * q.x;
        const float wy = q.w * q.y;
        const float wz = q.w * q.z;

        mat.m[0][0] = 1.0f - 2.0f * (yy + zz);
        mat.m[0][1] = 2.0f * (xy - wz);
        mat.m[0][2] = 2.0f * (xz + wy);
        mat.m[0][3] = pos.x;

        mat.m[1][0] = 2.0f * (xy + wz);
        mat.m[1][1] = 1.0f - 2.0f * (xx + zz);
        mat.m[1][2] = 2.0f * (yz - wx);
        mat.m[1][3] = pos.y;

        mat.m[2][0] = 2.0f * (xz - wy);
        mat.m[2][1] = 2.0f * (yz + wx);
        mat.m[2][2] = 1.0f - 2.0f * (xx + yy);
        mat.m[2][3] = pos.z;

        return mat;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3 TransformPoint(const Vector3& p) const noexcept {
        return {
            m[0][0] * p.x + m[0][1] * p.y + m[0][2] * p.z + m[0][3],
            m[1][0] * p.x + m[1][1] * p.y + m[1][2] * p.z + m[1][3],
            m[2][0] * p.x + m[2][1] * p.y + m[2][2] * p.z + m[2][3]
        };
    }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3 RotatePoint(const Vector3& p) const noexcept {
        return {
            m[0][0] * p.x + m[0][1] * p.y + m[0][2] * p.z,
            m[1][0] * p.x + m[1][1] * p.y + m[1][2] * p.z,
            m[2][0] * p.x + m[2][1] * p.y + m[2][2] * p.z
        };
    }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3 GetOrigin() const noexcept {
        return { m[0][3], m[1][3], m[2][3] };
    }

    [[nodiscard]] bool BitwiseEqual(const Matrix3x4& o) const noexcept {
        for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) {
            for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {
                if (m[r][c] != o.m[r][c]) return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
};

[[nodiscard]] constexpr Matrix3x4 LerpMatrix(const Matrix3x4& a, const Matrix3x4& b, float t) noexcept {
    Matrix3x4 out{};
    for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) {
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) {
            out.m[r][c] = a.m[r][c] + (b.m[r][c] - a.m[r][c]) * t;
        }
    }
    return out;
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB)
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct AABB {
    Vector3 mins{-16.0f, -16.0f, 0.0f};
    Vector3 maxs{16.0f, 16.0f, 72.0f};
};

/**
 * @brief Authoritative Lag Compensation History Record (LagRecord_t)
 * Reconstructed from server.dll Build 26598758 (CLagCompensationManager)
 */
struct LagRecord_t {
    uint32_t tickCount = 0;                                  // Server simulation tick index
    float simulationTime = 0.0f;                             // Authoritative simulation timestamp (seconds)
    float subTickFraction = 0.0f;                            // Continuous analog sub-tick offset [0.0, 1.0)
    uint8_t flags = 0;                                       // Bitmask of modified transforms
    Vector3 origin{};                                        // World-space pawn origin coordinates
    QAngle eyeAngles{};                                      // Eye/head orientation Euler angles
    Quaternion orientation{};                                // Unit quaternion rotation
    Vector3 mins{-16.0f, -16.0f, 0.0f};                      // Axis-aligned bounding box minimum
    Vector3 maxs{16.0f, 16.0f, 72.0f};                       // Axis-aligned bounding box maximum
    std::array<Matrix3x4, MAX_BONES> boneMatrices{};         // Resolved world-space bone transform cache
    size_t boneCount = 0;                                    // Active bone count (typically <= 128)
    Vector3 preTeleportOrigin{};                             // Spatial anchor for 4096.0 sqr distance check

    [[nodiscard]] bool BitwiseEqual(const LagRecord_t& o) const noexcept {
        if (tickCount != o.tickCount || simulationTime != o.simulationTime ||
            subTickFraction != o.subTickFraction || flags != o.flags ||
            boneCount != o.boneCount) return false;

        if (origin.x != o.origin.x || origin.y != o.origin.y || origin.z != o.origin.z) return false;
        if (!orientation.BitwiseEqual(o.orientation)) return false;
        if (mins.x != o.mins.x || mins.y != o.mins.y || mins.z != o.mins.z) return false;
        if (maxs.x != o.maxs.x || maxs.y != o.maxs.y || maxs.z != o.maxs.z) return false;

        for (size_t b = 0; b < boneCount; ++b) {
            if (!boneMatrices[b].BitwiseEqual(o.boneMatrices[b])) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
};

using LagRecord = LagRecord_t;

/**
 * @brief Pre-rewind Snapshot used by FinishLagCompensation to restore pawn states
 */
struct RestoreSnapshot_t {
    LagRecord_t snapshot{};
    bool isBacktracked = false;
    bool originModified = false;
    bool anglesModified = false;
    bool boundsModified = false;
    bool bonesModified = false;
};

/**
 * @brief 64-Tick Ring Buffer Tracking History for a Single Player Pawn
 * 1.000s retention at 64Hz (Build 26598758).
 */
struct PawnTrackHistory_t {
    uint32_t pawnIndex = 0;                                  // Pawn entity index in entity list
    EntityHandle handle{};                                   // 32-bit CEntityHandle (Index + Serial)
    std::deque<LagRecord_t> records;                         // Circular history buffer (64 ticks capacity)
    RestoreSnapshot_t restoreSnapshot;                       // Original state prior to rewind
    bool isBacktracked = false;                              // True if currently rewound for trace
};

using PawnHistory = PawnTrackHistory_t;

/**
 * @brief Reconstructed Server-Side Lag Compensation Engine from server.dll (Build 26598758)
 * Reverse-engineered from CLagCompensationManager:
 * - VTable @ 0x1819c7650
 * - StartLagCompensation (0x180ED27D0, RVA 0x00ED27D0)
 * - FinishLagCompensation (0x180EB8F40, RVA 0x00EB8F40)
 * - RestoreEntityTo (0x180ECDB00, RVA 0x00ECDB00)
 * - BacktrackPlayer / BacktrackEntity (0x180EC8950, RVA 0x00EC8950)
 */
class CLagCompensationServer {
public:
    static CLagCompensationServer& Get();

    /**
     * @brief Records authoritative pawn state into 64-tick ring buffer track.
     */
    void RecordDataIntoTrack(uint32_t pawnIndex, EntityHandle handle, float curTime, uint32_t tick,
                             float subTickFraction, const Vector3& origin, const QAngle& angles,
                             const Vector3& mins, const Vector3& maxs,
                             const Matrix3x4* bones, size_t boneCount, uint8_t flags = 0x1E);

    // Overload taking explicit Quaternion orientation
    void RecordDataIntoTrackQuat(uint32_t pawnIndex, EntityHandle handle, float curTime, uint32_t tick,
                                 float subTickFraction, const Vector3& origin, const Quaternion& orientation,
                                 const Vector3& mins, const Vector3& maxs,
                                 const Matrix3x4* bones, size_t boneCount, uint8_t flags = 0x1E);

    // Legacy compatibility overload
    void RecordPawn(uint32_t pawnIndex, float curTime, uint32_t tick,
                    const Vector3& origin, const QAngle& angles,
                    const Vector3& mins, const Vector3& maxs,
                    const Matrix3x4* bones, size_t boneCount);

    /**
     * @brief Rewinds all active target pawns to the client's continuous target timestamp.
     * Clamped to [latestTime - maxUnlag, latestTime] (sv_maxunlag: 200ms).
     * Reconstructed from CLagCompensationManager::StartLagCompensation @ 0x180ED27D0.
     */
    bool StartLagCompensation(uint32_t attackerIndex, float targetTime,
                              float maxUnlag = MAX_BACKTRACK_WINDOW);

    /**
     * @brief Sub-tick aware StartLagCompensation converting tick + w into continuous time:
     * t_target = (tick + w) * dt - t_interp.
     */
    bool StartLagCompensationSubTick(uint32_t attackerIndex, uint32_t targetTick,
                                     float subTickFraction, float flInterp = 0.0f,
                                     float maxUnlag = MAX_BACKTRACK_WINDOW);

    /**
     * @brief Restores all backtracked pawns back to their authoritative present states.
     * Reconstructed from CLagCompensationManager::FinishLagCompensation @ 0x180EB8F40.
     */
    void FinishLagCompensation();

    // Overload for single pawn index
    void FinishLagCompensation(uint32_t pawnIndex);

    /**
     * @brief Backtracks an individual entity by sampling/interpolating records.
     * Enforces the 4096.0 unit^2 (64.0 units) teleportation breaker check.
     * Reconstructed from CLagCompensationManager::BacktrackPlayer @ 0x180EC8950.
     */
    bool BacktrackEntity(PawnTrackHistory_t& pawn, float targetTime, LagRecord_t& outRecord);

    /**
     * @brief Direct alias matching VA 0x180EC8950.
     */
    bool BacktrackPlayer(PawnTrackHistory_t& pawn, float targetTime, LagRecord_t& outRecord) {
        return BacktrackEntity(pawn, targetTime, outRecord);
    }

    /**
     * @brief Restores an entity's physical state from snapshot.
     * Reconstructed from CLagCompensationManager::RestoreEntityTo @ 0x180ECDB00.
     */
    bool RestoreEntityTo(PawnTrackHistory_t& pawn, const LagRecord_t& record);

    /**
     * @brief Interpolates between two history records at continuous fraction [0.0, 1.0].
     * Uses geodesic Quaternion SLERP/NLERP and 3x4 affine bone matrix blending.
     */
    static bool InterpolateRecords(const LagRecord_t& older, const LagRecord_t& newer,
                                   float fraction, LagRecord_t& outRecord);

    /**
     * @brief Interpolates 3x4 affine bone matrices linearly with SIMD precision.
     */
    static bool InterpolateBones(const LagRecord_t& from, const LagRecord_t& to,
                                 float fraction, std::array<Matrix3x4, MAX_BONES>& outBones,
                                 size_t boneCount = MAX_BONES);

    /**
     * @brief Converts discrete tick base and analog sub-tick fraction into seconds:
     * t_target = (tick + w) * dt - t_interp.
     */
    [[nodiscard]] static constexpr float CalculateSubTickSimulationTime(
        uint32_t tick, float subTickFraction, float flInterp = 0.0f,
        float tickInterval = TICK_INTERVAL_64) noexcept {
        return (static_cast<float>(tick) + std::clamp(subTickFraction, 0.0f, 1.0f)) * tickInterval - flInterp;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<PawnTrackHistory_t>& GetPawns() const noexcept { return m_Pawns; }
    void ClearHistory() noexcept { m_Pawns.clear(); }

private:
    CLagCompensationServer() = default;
    std::vector<PawnTrackHistory_t> m_Pawns;

    PawnTrackHistory_t* GetOrCreatePawn(uint32_t pawnIndex, EntityHandle handle = {});
};

using CLagCompensationManager = CLagCompensationServer;

} // namespace cs2::server

#endif // CS2_SERVER_LAGCOMPENSATION_H
```

```cpp
#ifndef CS2_SHARED_ENTITY_HANDLE_H
#define CS2_SHARED_ENTITY_HANDLE_H

#include <cstdint>

namespace cs2::shared {

constexpr std::uint32_t ENT_ENTRY_MASK        = 0x7FFF;
constexpr std::uint32_t INVALID_EHANDLE_INDEX = 0x7FFF;
constexpr std::uint32_t INVALID_EHANDLE_VAL   = 0xFFFFFFFF;

/**
 * @brief Source 2 32-bit Packed Entity Handle (CEntityHandle)
 * Reconstructed from client.dll @ 0x1807357c0 (GetEntityIdentity).
 * Decomposition:
 *   - Bits 0..14:  15-bit entry index [0..32,767]
 *   - Bits 15..31: 17-bit serial counter (incremented upon entity recycling)
 */
struct CEntityHandle {
    std::uint32_t m_uValue{INVALID_EHANDLE_VAL};

    constexpr CEntityHandle() noexcept = default;
    constexpr explicit CEntityHandle(std::uint32_t val) noexcept : m_uValue(val) {}
    constexpr CEntityHandle(std::uint32_t index, std::uint32_t serial) noexcept
        : m_uValue((index & ENT_ENTRY_MASK) | (serial << 15)) {}

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsValid() const noexcept {
        return m_uValue != INVALID_EHANDLE_VAL && GetEntryIndex() != INVALID_EHANDLE_INDEX;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t GetRaw() const noexcept {
        return m_uValue;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t GetEntryIndex() const noexcept {
        return m_uValue & ENT_ENTRY_MASK;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t GetSerialNumber() const noexcept {
        return m_uValue >> 15;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t GetChunkIndex() const noexcept {
        return GetEntryIndex() >> 9;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr std::uint32_t GetSlotIndex() const noexcept {
        return GetEntryIndex() & 0x1FF;
    }

    constexpr bool operator==(const CEntityHandle& o) const noexcept { return m_uValue == o.m_uValue; }
    constexpr bool operator!=(const CEntityHandle& o) const noexcept { return m_uValue != o.m_uValue; }
    constexpr bool operator<(const CEntityHandle& o) const noexcept { return m_uValue < o.m_uValue; }
};
static_assert(sizeof(CEntityHandle) == 4, "CEntityHandle must be 4 bytes");

/**
 * @brief Strongly typed entity handle template (CHandle<T>)
 */
template <typename T>
class CHandle : public CEntityHandle {
public:
    using CEntityHandle::CEntityHandle;
};
static_assert(sizeof(CHandle<void>) == 4, "CHandle<T> must be 4 bytes");

} // namespace cs2::shared

#endif // CS2_SHARED_ENTITY_HANDLE_H
```

```cpp
#ifndef CS2_SHARED_HITBOX_H
#define CS2_SHARED_HITBOX_H

#include <cstdint>
#include "math_types.h"

namespace cs2::shared {

enum HitGroup_t : std::int32_t {
    HITGROUP_GENERIC   = 0,
    HITGROUP_HEAD      = 1,
    HITGROUP_CHEST     = 2,
    HITGROUP_STOMACH   = 3,
    HITGROUP_LEFTARM   = 4,
    HITGROUP_RIGHTARM  = 5,
    HITGROUP_LEFTLEG   = 6,
    HITGROUP_RIGHTLEG  = 7,
    HITGROUP_NECK      = 8,
    HITGROUP_UNUSED    = 9,
    HITGROUP_GEAR      = 10
};

/**
 * @brief Returns the authoritative CS2 damage multiplier for a target hitgroup.
 * Head: 4.0x, Stomach: 1.25x, Chest: 1.0x, Limbs: 0.75x.
 */
inline constexpr float GetHitGroupDamageMultiplier(HitGroup_t group) noexcept {
    switch (group) {
        case HITGROUP_HEAD:     return 4.00f;
        case HITGROUP_STOMACH:  return 1.25f;
        case HITGROUP_CHEST:    return 1.00f;
        case HITGROUP_LEFTARM:
        case HITGROUP_RIGHTARM:
        case HITGROUP_LEFTLEG:
        case HITGROUP_RIGHTLEG: return 0.75f;
        default:                return 1.00f;
    }
}

/**
 * @brief Studio bone hitbox bounding capsule / OBB (CHitBox)
 * Size: exactly 112 bytes (0x70)
 */
struct CHitBox {
    const char*   m_pName{nullptr};           // +0x00: Hitbox bone identifier string
    const char*   m_pSurfaceProperty{nullptr};// +0x08: Material physics surface
    const char*   m_pBoneName{nullptr};       // +0x10: Target skeleton bone
    Vector3D      m_vMinBounds{};             // +0x18: Local minimum bounding coordinates (12 bytes)
    Vector3D      m_vMaxBounds{};             // +0x24: Local maximum bounding coordinates (12 bytes)
    float         m_flShapeRadius{0.0f};      // +0x30: Capsule mantle radius
    std::uint32_t m_nBoneId{0};               // +0x34: Skeletal bone index
    std::int32_t  m_nHitGroup{0};             // +0x38: Authoritative HitGroup_t
    std::uint8_t  m_nPad[52]{};               // +0x3C: Studio model runtime padding
};
static_assert(sizeof(CHitBox) == 0x70, "CHitBox must be exactly 0x70 (112 bytes)");
```

```cpp
#ifndef CS2_SHARED_MATH_TYPES_H
#define CS2_SHARED_MATH_TYPES_H

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>

namespace cs2::shared {

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Vector2D
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct Vector2D {
    float x{0.0f}, y{0.0f};

    constexpr Vector2D() = default;
    constexpr Vector2D(float fx, float fy) : x(fx), y(fy) {}

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Vector2D operator+(const Vector2D& o) const noexcept { return {x + o.x, y + o.y}; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Vector2D operator-(const Vector2D& o) const noexcept { return {x - o.x, y - o.y}; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Vector2D operator*(float s) const noexcept { return {x * s, y * s}; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Vector2D operator/(float s) const noexcept { return {x / s, y / s}; }

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr float Dot(const Vector2D& o) const noexcept { return x * o.x + y * o.y; }
    [[nodiscard]] float Length() const noexcept { return std::sqrt(x * x + y * y); }
};
static_assert(sizeof(Vector2D) == 8, "Vector2D must be 8 bytes");

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Vector3D (12 bytes, matching Source 2 core memory layout)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct Vector3D {
    float x{0.0f}, y{0.0f}, z{0.0f};

    constexpr Vector3D() = default;
    constexpr Vector3D(float fx, float fy, float fz) : x(fx), y(fy), z(fz) {}

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Vector3D operator+(const Vector3D& o) const noexcept { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Vector3D operator-(const Vector3D& o) const noexcept { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Vector3D operator*(float s) const noexcept { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr Vector3D operator/(float s) const noexcept { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }

    constexpr Vector3D& operator+=(const Vector3D& o) noexcept { x += o.x; y += o.y; z += o.z; return *this; }
    constexpr Vector3D& operator-=(const Vector3D& o) noexcept { x -= o.x; y -= o.y; z -= o.z; return *this; }
    constexpr Vector3D& operator*=(float s) noexcept { x *= s; y *= s; z *= s; return *this; }

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr float Dot(const Vector3D& o) const noexcept { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }
    [[nodiscard]] float Length() const noexcept { return std::sqrt(Dot(*this)); }
    [[nodiscard]] float LengthSq() const noexcept { return Dot(*this); }
    [[nodiscard]] float Length2D() const noexcept { return std::sqrt(x * x + y * y); }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3D Cross(const Vector3D& o) const noexcept {
        return {
            y * o.z - z * o.y,
            z * o.x - x * o.z,
            x * o.y - y * o.x
        };
    }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3D Normalized() const noexcept {
        const float len = Length();
        return (len > 1e-6f) ? (*this / len) : Vector3D{};
    }

    [[nodiscard]] bool IsZero(float tol = 1e-6f) const noexcept {
        return std::abs(x) < tol && std::abs(y) < tol && std::abs(z) < tol;
    }
};
static_assert(sizeof(Vector3D) == 12, "Vector3D must be 12 bytes");

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Vector4D (16 bytes)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct alignas(16) Vector4D {
    float x{0.0f}, y{0.0f}, z{0.0f}, w{0.0f};

    constexpr Vector4D() = default;
    constexpr Vector4D(float fx, float fy, float fz, float fw = 0.0f) : x(fx), y(fy), z(fz), w(fw) {}
};
static_assert(sizeof(Vector4D) == 16, "Vector4D must be 16 bytes");

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// QAngle (Euler angles in degrees: pitch, yaw, roll)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct QAngle {
    float pitch{0.0f}; // X
    float yaw{0.0f};   // Y
    float roll{0.0f};  // Z

    constexpr QAngle() = default;
    constexpr QAngle(float p, float y, float r = 0.0f) : pitch(p), yaw(y), roll(r) {}

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr QAngle operator+(const QAngle& o) const noexcept { return {pitch + o.pitch, yaw + o.yaw, roll + o.roll}; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr QAngle operator-(const QAngle& o) const noexcept { return {pitch - o.pitch, yaw - o.yaw, roll - o.roll}; }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr QAngle operator*(float s) const noexcept { return {pitch * s, yaw * s, roll * s}; }

    void Clamp() noexcept {
        pitch = std::clamp(pitch, -89.0f, 89.0f);
        while (yaw > 180.0f) yaw -= 360.0f;
        while (yaw < -180.0f) yaw += 360.0f;
        roll = 0.0f;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3D Forward() const noexcept {
        const float sp = std::sin(pitch * (3.14159265f / 180.0f));
        const float cp = std::cos(pitch * (3.14159265f / 180.0f));
        const float sy = std::sin(yaw * (3.14159265f / 180.0f));
        const float cy = std::cos(yaw * (3.14159265f / 180.0f));
        return {cp * cy, cp * sy, -sp};
    }
};
static_assert(sizeof(QAngle) == 12, "QAngle must be 12 bytes");

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// VMatrix (64 bytes, alignas(16), 4x4 row-major transformation matrix)
// client.dll active view matrix global @ client.dll + 0x256cfe0
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct alignas(16) VMatrix {
    float m[4][4]{};

    constexpr VMatrix() = default;

    static VMatrix Identity() noexcept {
        VMatrix res;
        res.m[0][0] = 1.0f; res.m[1][1] = 1.0f; res.m[2][2] = 1.0f; res.m[3][3] = 1.0f;
        return res;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] const float* operator[](int i) const noexcept { return m[i]; }
    [[nodiscard]] float* operator[](int i) noexcept { return m[i]; }

    /**
     * @brief Transforms 3D world coordinate into 2D normalized screen space.
     * Homogeneous clipping: rejects vertices behind the camera (w < 0.001f).
     */
    [[nodiscard]] bool WorldToScreen(const Vector3D& world, Vector2D& screen, int screenWidth, int screenHeight) const noexcept {
        const float w = m[3][0] * world.x + m[3][1] * world.y + m[3][2] * world.z + m[3][3];
        if (w < 0.001f) return false;

        const float invW = 1.0f / w;
        const float ndcX = (m[0][0] * world.x + m[0][1] * world.y + m[0][2] * world.z + m[0][3]) * invW;
        const float ndcY = (m[1][0] * world.x + m[1][1] * world.y + m[1][2] * world.z + m[1][3]) * invW;

        screen.x = (screenWidth * 0.5f) + (ndcX * screenWidth * 0.5f);
        screen.y = (screenHeight * 0.5f) - (ndcY * screenHeight * 0.5f);
        return true;
    }
};
static_assert(sizeof(VMatrix) == 64, "VMatrix must be 64 bytes");

} // namespace cs2::shared

#endif // CS2_SHARED_MATH_TYPES_H
```

```cpp
/**
 * @brief 64-byte Geometric Query Ray & Swept Extent Volume.
 * Reconstructed from client.dll @ 0x180a1ae30 / vphysics2.dll @ 0x1802544a0.
 */
struct alignas(16) Ray_t {
    Vector3D      m_vStart;         // +0x00: Ray segment trajectory origin (12 bytes)
    Vector3D      m_vEnd;           // +0x0C: Ray segment trajectory terminus (12 bytes)
    Vector3D      m_vOffset;        // +0x18: Swept centroid displacement vector (12 bytes)
    Vector3D      m_vExtent;        // +0x24: Half-extent bounding box dimensions (12 bytes)
    bool          m_bIsRay;         // +0x30: True if line ray (extent == 0), false if swept volume (1 byte)
    bool          m_bHasExtents;    // +0x31: True if swept volume possesses non-zero bounds (1 byte)
    CS2_PAD(0x06, m_pad32);         // +0x32: Alignment padding
    std::uint64_t m_nMask;          // +0x38: 64-bit spatial collision mask (8 bytes)

    void Init(const Vector3D& start, const Vector3D& end, std::uint64_t mask = Contents::MASK_SHOT) noexcept {
        m_vStart = start;
        m_vEnd = end;
        m_vOffset = Vector3D{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
        m_vExtent = Vector3D{0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
        m_bIsRay = true;
        m_bHasExtents = false;
        m_nMask = mask;
    }
};
static_assert(sizeof(Ray_t) == 0x40, "Ray_t must be exactly 64 bytes (0x40)");

/**
 * @brief 72-byte Spatial Query Filter (CTraceFilter).
 * Reconstructed from client.dll VTable @ 0x181ad4838.
 */
struct CTraceFilter {

    std::uint64_t  m_nTraceMask{ Contents::MASK_SHOT }; // +0x08: 64-bit spatial filtering bitmask
    std::uint64_t  m_v1[2]{ 0, 0 };            // +0x10: Internal collision flags
    std::uint32_t  m_nSkipHandles[2]{ 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF }; // +0x20: Entity handle exclusion pair
    std::uint16_t  m_nCollisions[2]{ 0, 0 };   // +0x28: Collision class indicators

        m_nSkipHandles[0] = skipHandle;
    }

        return true;
    }
};
static_assert(sizeof(CTraceFilter) == 0x48, "CTraceFilter must be exactly 72 bytes (0x48)");

/**
 * @brief 192-byte Authoritative Ray Intersection & Physics Query Result (GameTrace_t).
 * Reconstructed from client.dll. Contains the 40-byte internal Rubikon physics sweep buffer.
 */
struct alignas(16) GameTrace_t {
    void*         m_pSurface{ nullptr };       // +0x00: Surface physics descriptor pointer
    void*         m_pHitEntity{ nullptr };     // +0x08: Hit C_BaseEntity entity pointer
    void*         m_pHitboxData{ nullptr };    // +0x10: Target hitbox runtime descriptor pointer
    std::uint64_t m_nContents{ 0 };            // +0x18: Point contents flags at hit position
    std::uint64_t m_nHitBoxIndex{ 0 };         // +0x20: Hitbox bone index
    CS2_PAD(0x08, m_pad28);                    // +0x28
    Vector3D      m_vStartPos{};               // +0x30: Trajectory origin position
    CS2_PAD(0x04, m_pad3c);                    // +0x3C
    Vector3D      m_vEndPos{};                 // +0x40: Trajectory terminus position
    CS2_PAD(0x04, m_pad4c);                    // +0x4C
    std::uint8_t  m_rubikonBuffer[40]{};       // +0x50: Internal Rubikon sweep buffer (0x28 bytes)
    Vector3D      m_vRayStart{};               // +0x78: Exact evaluated ray entry vector
    Vector3D      m_vRayEnd{};                 // +0x84: Exact evaluated ray exit vector
    CS2_PAD(0x08, m_pad90);                    // +0x90
    CS2_PAD(0x04, m_pad98);                    // +0x98
    Vector3D      m_vHitNormal{};              // +0x9C: Surface unit normal vector at intersection
    std::uint32_t m_nSpatialVolumeIndex{ 0 };  // +0xA8: Rubikon spatial subdivision cell / hitgroup ID
    float         m_flFraction{ 1.0f };        // +0xAC: Intersection fraction [0.0..1.0] along ray (1.0 = miss)
    std::uint64_t m_nHitFlags{ 0 };            // +0xB0: Intersection status flags
    std::uint16_t m_nSurfaceFlags{ 0 };        // +0xB8: Physical material surface descriptor flags
    std::uint8_t  m_bStartSolid{ 0 };          // +0xBA: True if ray started inside a solid geometry volume
    CS2_PAD(0x05, m_padbb);                    // +0xBB

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool DidHit() const noexcept {
        return m_flFraction < 1.0f || m_bStartSolid;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr bool IsVisible() const noexcept {
        return m_flFraction > 0.97f && !m_bStartSolid;
    }
};
static_assert(sizeof(GameTrace_t) == 0xC0, "GameTrace_t must be exactly 192 bytes (0xC0)");
```

```cpp
// ============================================================================
// Source 2 Schema Core Types & Field Accessor Macro
// Auto-generated by tools/generate_schema_classes.py
// Standard: ISO C++20 (/std:c++20 /W4 /WX)
// ============================================================================
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <type_traits>

#include "../entity_handle.h"
#include "../math_types.h"

namespace cs2::schema {

// Import core geometric and handle types
using CEntityHandle = cs2::shared::CEntityHandle;
using Vector3       = cs2::shared::Vector3D;
using QAngle        = cs2::shared::QAngle;

// Forward declarations for pointer targets
class CGameSceneNode;
using CGameSceneNodePtr = CGameSceneNode*;

/**
 * @def SCHEMA_FIELD
 * @brief Zero-overhead C++20 field accessor macro.
 * 
 * Expands to non-const and const member accessors returning lvalue references:
 *   - Non-const: provides mutable lvalue reference to memory at this + offset.
 *   - Const:     provides read-only const lvalue reference.
 * 
 * Uses std::add_pointer_t<std::add_const_t<type>> to seamlessly support both
 * fundamental/value types and pointer types (e.g. CGameSceneNode*) without
 * cv-qualifier conversion conflicts.
 */
#ifndef SCHEMA_FIELD
#define SCHEMA_FIELD(type, name, offset) \
    [[nodiscard]] std::add_lvalue_reference_t<type> name() noexcept { \
        return *reinterpret_cast<type*>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(this) + offset); \
    } \
    [[nodiscard]] std::add_lvalue_reference_t<std::add_const_t<type>> name() const noexcept { \
        return *reinterpret_cast<std::add_pointer_t<std::add_const_t<type>>>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(this) + offset); \
    }
#endif

} // namespace cs2::schema
```

### File: `game/shared/skeleton.h` (shared)
```cpp
#ifndef CS2_SHARED_SKELETON_H
#define CS2_SHARED_SKELETON_H

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include "math_types.h"
#include "entity_handle.h"

namespace cs2::shared {

// ============================================================================
// Bone Calculation & Usage Flags
// Reconstructed from client.dll & animationsystem.dll
// ============================================================================
enum BoneFlags_t : std::uint32_t {
    BONE_FLAG_NONE               = 0,
    BONE_FLAG_CALCULATED         = (1u << 0),  // 0x0001: Bone has been evaluated this frame
    BONE_FLAG_INTERPOLATED       = (1u << 1),  // 0x0002: Inter-tick interpolation completed
    BONE_FLAG_WORLD_SPACE        = (1u << 2),  // 0x0004: Bone is in world coordinate space
    BONE_USED_BY_HITBOX          = (1u << 8),  // 0x0100: Bone drives collision/hitbox geometry
    BONE_USED_BY_ATTACHMENT      = (1u << 9),  // 0x0200: Bone drives attachments (weapons, muzzle, optics)
    BONE_USED_BY_VERTEX_LOD0     = (1u << 10), // 0x0400: Bone used in primary LOD0 skinning
    BONE_USED_BY_BONE_MERGE      = (1u << 11), // 0x0800: Bone participates in bone merge cache
    BONE_USED_BY_ANYTHING        = 0x0007FF00u
};

// ============================================================================
// 3x4 Transformation Matrix (matrix3x4_t)
// 48 bytes (3 rows, 4 columns: 3x3 rotation/scale + translation column)
// Standard Source 2 matrix format for skeletal skinning and lag compensation.
// ============================================================================
struct matrix3x4_t {
    float m[3][4]{};

    constexpr matrix3x4_t() noexcept = default;

    [[nodiscard]] const float* operator[](int i) const noexcept { return m[i]; }
    [[nodiscard]] float* operator[](int i) noexcept { return m[i]; }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3D GetOrigin() const noexcept {
        return {m[0][3], m[1][3], m[2][3]};
    }

    void SetOrigin(const Vector3D& origin) noexcept {
        m[0][3] = origin.x;
        m[1][3] = origin.y;
        m[2][3] = origin.z;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3D TransformVector(const Vector3D& in) const noexcept {
        return {
            m[0][0] * in.x + m[0][1] * in.y + m[0][2] * in.z + m[0][3],
            m[1][0] * in.x + m[1][1] * in.y + m[1][2] * in.z + m[1][3],
            m[2][0] * in.x + m[2][1] * in.y + m[2][2] * in.z + m[2][3]
        };
    }

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3D RotateVector(const Vector3D& in) const noexcept {
        return {
            m[0][0] * in.x + m[0][1] * in.y + m[0][2] * in.z,
            m[1][0] * in.x + m[1][1] * in.y + m[1][2] * in.z,
            m[2][0] * in.x + m[2][1] * in.y + m[2][2] * in.z
        };
    }

    static matrix3x4_t Identity() noexcept {
        matrix3x4_t mat;
        mat.m[0][0] = 1.0f; mat.m[1][1] = 1.0f; mat.m[2][2] = 1.0f;
        return mat;
    }
};
static_assert(sizeof(matrix3x4_t) == 48, "matrix3x4_t must be exactly 48 bytes (0x30)");

// ============================================================================
// Source 2 32-Byte CTransform (Quaternion + Position + Scale)
// Reconstructed from client.dll & animationsystem.dll
// Reference: docs/09_skeleton_bone_hierarchy_and_animgraph.md
// ============================================================================
struct CTransform {
    // Rotation Quaternion (qx, qy, qz, qw)
    float qx{0.0f}, qy{0.0f}, qz{0.0f}, qw{1.0f}; // +0x00 (16 bytes)

    // Position Vector (px, py, pz)
    float px{0.0f}, py{0.0f}, pz{0.0f};          // +0x10 (12 bytes)

    // Uniform Scale Factor
    float scale{1.0f};                           // +0x1C (4 bytes)

    constexpr CTransform() noexcept = default;
    constexpr CTransform(float _qx, float _qy, float _qz, float _qw,
                         float _px, float _py, float _pz, float _scale = 1.0f) noexcept
        : qx(_qx), qy(_qy), qz(_qz), qw(_qw), px(_px), py(_py), pz(_pz), scale(_scale) {}

    [[nodiscard]] Vector3D GetPosition() const noexcept { return {px, py, pz}; }
    void SetPosition(const Vector3D& pos) noexcept { px = pos.x; py = pos.y; pz = pos.z; }

    /**
     * @brief Rotate a 3D vector using Rodrigues formula (zero trig calls, pure multiply-adds).
     * Reconstructed from client.dll @ FUN_181748480.
     */
    [[nodiscard]] Vector3D RotateVector(const Vector3D& v) const noexcept {
        const float tx = 2.0f * (qy * v.z - qz * v.y);
        const float ty = 2.0f * (qz * v.x - qx * v.z);
        const float tz = 2.0f * (qx * v.y - qy * v.x);

        return {
            v.x + qw * tx + (qy * tz - qz * ty),
            v.y + qw * ty + (qz * tx - qx * tz),
            v.z + qw * tz + (qx * ty - qy * tx)
        };
    }

    /**
     * @brief Transforms local point to world space: p_world = p_trans + scale * Rotate(v).
     */
    [[nodiscard]] Vector3D TransformPoint(const Vector3D& point) const noexcept {
        const Vector3D rot = RotateVector(point);
        return {px + scale * rot.x, py + scale * rot.y, pz + scale * rot.z};
    }

    /**
     * @brief Concatenates parent transform and child local transform.
     * Reconstructed from client.dll @ FUN_181748480.
     */
    static void ConcatenateTransforms(const CTransform& parent, const CTransform& child, CTransform* out) noexcept {
        // 1. Position: p_out = p_parent + s_parent * Rotate(p_child)
        const Vector3D childPos{child.px, child.py, child.pz};
        const Vector3D rotChildPos = parent.RotateVector(childPos);
        out->px = parent.px + parent.scale * rotChildPos.x;
        out->py = parent.py + parent.scale * rotChildPos.y;
        out->pz = parent.pz + parent.scale * rotChildPos.z;

        // 2. Rotation: q_out = q_parent * q_child (Hamilton product)
        const float nx = parent.qw * child.qx + parent.qx * child.qw + parent.qy * child.qz - parent.qz * child.qy;
        const float ny = parent.qw * child.qy - parent.qx * child.qz + parent.qy * child.qw + parent.qz * child.qx;
        const float nz = parent.qw * child.qz + parent.qx * child.qy - parent.qy * child.qx + parent.qz * child.qw;
        const float nw = parent.qw * child.qw - parent.qx * child.qx - parent.qy * child.qy - parent.qz * child.qz;

        // Normalize resulting quaternion
        const float lenSq = nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz + nw * nw;
        if (lenSq > 1e-8f) {
            const float invLen = 1.0f / std::sqrt(lenSq);
            out->qx = nx * invLen;
            out->qy = ny * invLen;
            out->qz = nz * invLen;
            out->qw = nw * invLen;
        } else {
            out->qx = 0.0f; out->qy = 0.0f; out->qz = 0.0f; out->qw = 1.0f;
        }

        // 3. Scale: s_out = s_parent * s_child
        out->scale = parent.scale * child.scale;
    }

    /**
     * @brief Converts 32-byte CTransform to 48-byte matrix3x4_t format.
     */
    [[nodiscard]] matrix3x4_t ToMatrix3x4() const noexcept {
        matrix3x4_t mat;
        const float xx = qx * qx;
        const float yy = qy * qy;
        const float zz = qz * qz;
        const float xy = qx * qy;
        const float xz = qx * qz;
        const float yz = qy * qz;
        const float wx = qw * qx;
        const float wy = qw * qy;
        const float wz = qw * qz;

        mat.m[0][0] = (1.0f - 2.0f * (yy + zz)) * scale;
        mat.m[0][1] = (2.0f * (xy - wz)) * scale;
        mat.m[0][2] = (2.0f * (xz + wy)) * scale;
        mat.m[0][3] = px;

        mat.m[1][0] = (2.0f * (xy + wz)) * scale;
        mat.m[1][1] = (1.0f - 2.0f * (xx + zz)) * scale;
        mat.m[1][2] = (2.0f * (yz - wx)) * scale;
        mat.m[1][3] = py;

        mat.m[2][0] = (2.0f * (xz - wy)) * scale;
        mat.m[2][1] = (2.0f * (yz + wx)) * scale;
        mat.m[2][2] = (1.0f - 2.0f * (xx + yy)) * scale;
        mat.m[2][3] = pz;

        return mat;
    }
};
static_assert(sizeof(CTransform) == 32, "CTransform must be exactly 32 bytes (0x20)");

// ============================================================================
```
```cpp
// Source 2 Spatial Audio, Acoustic Wave Propagation & Operator Dispatcher
//
// Clean-room reconstructed from:
// - soundsystem.dll (VTable @ 0x1804AB140, ISoundOpSystem "SoundOpSystem001")

//    and physical barrier acoustic transmission / occlusion raycasting.
// 2. Indirect Sound Path: 2nd-order Ambisonics B-format spherical harmonics
//    (ACN / SN3D: W, Y, Z, X, V, T, R, S, U), statistical reverberation modeling

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Octave Band Representation (3 Standard Acoustic Bands)
// Steam Audio / Source 2 default frequency centers: Low (400 Hz), Mid (2.5 kHz), High (15 kHz)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
struct OctaveBand3 {
    float low{ 0.0f };   // Centered at 400 Hz (Bass fundamental, structural resonance)
    float mid{ 0.0f };   // Centered at 2500 Hz (Speech intelligibility, presence)
    float high{ 0.0f };  // Centered at 15000 Hz (Air absorption roll-off, brilliance)

    constexpr OctaveBand3() noexcept = default;
    constexpr OctaveBand3(float l, float m, float h) noexcept : low(l), mid(m), high(h) {}

    [[nodiscard]] constexpr OctaveBand3 operator+(const OctaveBand3& o) const noexcept {
        return { low + o.low, mid + o.mid, high + o.high };
    }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr OctaveBand3 operator-(const OctaveBand3& o) const noexcept {
        return { low - o.low, mid - o.mid, high - o.high };
    }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr OctaveBand3 operator*(float s) const noexcept {
        return { low * s, mid * s, high * s };
    }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr OctaveBand3 operator*(const OctaveBand3& o) const noexcept {
        return { low * o.low, mid * o.mid, high * o.high };
    }
    constexpr OctaveBand3& operator+=(const OctaveBand3& o) noexcept {
        low += o.low; mid += o.mid; high += o.high; return *this;
    }
    constexpr OctaveBand3& operator*=(float s) noexcept {
        low *= s; mid *= s; high *= s; return *this;
    }
    [[nodiscard]] constexpr float Average() const noexcept {
        return (low + mid + high) / 3.0f;
    }
};

    float                   maxDistance{ 50.0f };    // Distance beyond which sound attenuates to silence (meters)
    float                   rolloffFactor{ 1.0f };  // Curve steepness multiplier

};
```
